description: A document's identity and its table of contents (turinys), WITHOUT its text. Call this before reading: the Civil Code (Civilinis kodeksas) runs to 1.7 million characters. Ids come from search results (įstatymas or nutartis).

document_id.description: The `id` of a search hit, or the `document.id` beside it. NOT `document.number`, which is the act's official number (`XIII-2221`) and is not an id.
document_id.title: Document Id

jurisdiction.description: Which jurisdiction the id belongs to (`LT`). Omit for the account's own.
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

name: get_document
title: Document and contents
